description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Switch' that acts as a decorator to switch between two attribute definitions based on a token in the context. It's part of the 'htmlpurifier' library, specifically in the attribute validation section for handling tag-specific attributes in HTML purification.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Switch
classes.description: A decorator class that chooses between two attribute definitions based on the current token in the context, enabling conditional validation for HTML attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the switch object with a specific tag and two attribute definitions, one for matching tokens and one for non-matching tokens.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input string by delegating to either the 'withTag' or 'withoutTag' attribute definition based on the current token from the context.
